text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while on my way to the track before training…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh no.
choice_data_list: Sky? The track's the other way.
Sky? The track's the other way.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah. Uh, I was just gonna go… grab us something to drink.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her insincerity is blatantly obvious. This must mean…
choice_data_list: So you were planning on skipping?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No waaay, of course I'd never!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, maybe I was, but maybe I wasn't… Nah, I was totally going to. ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Teehee. ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Can't we take the day off? Pleeease, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: C'mon, the weather's so nice! Lift your head and look at that good stuff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's right. The sunshine's warm and comforting…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sunlight might always look the same, but the truth is, it's different every day.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Every ray's as unique as a snowflake. We only have a moment to enjoy each one.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So, you get how important it is to take a break now, right?
choice_data_list: I understand that you want to take the day off…
I understand that you want to take the day off…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Come on! I painted such an enchanting picture just now!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But you see, we can get something good out of taking a break… maybe… Yeah, probably not, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If I force her, it'll likely mess with her motivation… There's no way we can train like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But what should I do?
choice_data_list: Let her rest until she's happy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: HUH?!
choice_data_list: Why not enjoy the sunshine while you run?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No way! I wanna snooze on a soft patch of grass!
choice_data_list: But collapsing from exhaustion out on the turf would feel great too!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Urgh, so you're not gonna give up? Then I guess…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Aaarrgghhh!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…
choice_data_list: You ran really well out there!
You ran really well out there!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huff… You said it yourself.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That collapsing from exhaustion out on the turf would feel good. So I ran with everything I had…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now I'm gonna lie down here, and you can't stop me! Ahhh… It actually does feel pretty good. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I suppose listening to you pays off sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, what are you doing standing up? Come lie down already!
choice_data_list: You want me to rest too?
You want me to rest too?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, no one's looking. Just slide on down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so I lie down on the turf with a worn-out Seiun Sky, and we enjoy the breeze together.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm outta here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky runs off in a frenzied dash, right toward…

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Helloooo! One hefty menchi-katsu sandwich pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Right now's when that store finishes making their super popular "hefty" menchi-katsu sandwich. Each one weighs a whole kilo.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: All I have to do is slip into the hungry crowd. There's no way Trainer will be able to get past everyone. Then… I win. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just when I realize she's about to make her escape, an idea strikes me.
choice_data_list: Sky said she doesn't want her hefty menchi-katsu sandwich!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: She doesn't?! Then I'll have hers!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Using the crowd against me?! Ngh… I don't have the power to hold 'em all back!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Gotta find a way out fast. If I can get away before anyone figures out what's what…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm already in hot water! What should I do?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Ugh, you're such a schemer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I manage to apprehend Seiun Sky, but now she seems to be in low spirits.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wait, there's no way. You must have an ulterior motive.
choice_data_list: Sometimes we just have to rest as much as we want.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa! You're so generous, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll take you on a tour of my napping spots! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaah. ♪ This is one of my special napping nooks.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yep. Well, I've been using the place off and on since before it was yours.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's calm, it's quiet—it's a tip-top nap spot!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, you're not looking too thrilled there.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You know I don't lavish this kind of praise on just any old spot.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yep. That's just how it is. Well, see ya when I wake up.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yawn…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward, I gently move the sofa in my room so it catches the sun. That way, the happily snoozing Seiun Sky can rest in its comforting rays.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I nap here, and…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I nap here, aaand…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, here too. And here, and here, and here…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Aaand here too!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Really? Well, I guess we can chill out here for today.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: And after that, well… I'll run off someplace else.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You never know, there might be some places I'm still not showing you.
choice_data_list: Was this all part of some scheme?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You didn't actually think I'd reveal my real napping spots, did you? Come on, you'd start finding me straight away.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But now that I've shown you so many of them, you'll have to check them all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ready to come find me? I'll be waiting! ☆ Hehe, just kidding!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky seems fully committed to her practice-skipping lifestyle.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh? So can I start by resting now?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You're not worried I'll try to trick you and keep skipping practice forever and ever?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: If I let you rest now, you won't skip out on me. I know you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You know when you say that kinda thing, it makes me wanna do the opposite, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But since you're being so honest, I can't do ya like that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So might as well stick to the plan. Come on, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, between her periodic breaks, Seiun Sky works hard during the training session.
